candidate.definition_en: Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance.
candidate.explanation_ar: وفي ومخلص، الشخص اللي مبيخونش وبيفضل ثابت على العهد.

senses.definition_en: Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance to a person, country, or cause.
senses.explanation_ar: وفي ومخلص لشخص أو جهة أو مبدأ.
examples: He is a loyal friend who always supports those he cares about.
The shop has many loyal customers who return every week.
She remained loyal to her principles despite facing severe criticism.
